lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 primary high-contrast vertical white lines traversing the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the central mass, with approximately 30-40 pixel intervals between segments at the midline.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 6th line from the anterior, splitting into a Y-shape toward the ventral belly line. Partial merging of line 10 and 11 occurs near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Three abbreviated dashed segments are visible on the posterior flank, terminating approximately 40% of the way down the torso height without reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 7 distinct white spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb, concentrated in a 100x100 pixel area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Four spots on the upper hind limb align to form a semi-connected horizontal geometric line approximately parallel to the knee joint.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron patch on the muzzle and a distinct white horizontal band across the lower throat area.
